responsibility: Core machine description for the LoongArch backend. It defines the target’s unspec/unspecv codes, attributes, constants, iterators, instruction patterns, expanders, splitters, peepholes, and scheduling attribute taxonomy, and includes the companion predicate, constraint, atomic, and pipeline-description md files; the generated recognizers and expanders from this file drive RTL instruction selection and assembly emission for LoongArch.
same_name_distinction: For the loongarch same-name set, this is the machine-description source that defines RTL patterns, attributes, unspec codes, peepholes, and includes pipeline/atomic companion md files for instruction selection and scheduling. Unlike loongarch.cc, loongarch.h, and loongarch.opt, it is declarative .md pattern data rather than C++ backend logic, target macros, or option records.
